name: Onna Senshi Kureha ~Toride no Goblin~
original_name: 女戦士クレハ～砦のゴブリン～
source:
Kureha has been asked to vanquish the goblin who resides in a fortress near her village.
She immediately sets out to toward the fortress where her target lays in wait, however...
Kureha is blissfully unaware of the twisted sexual drama that is about to take place in that very fortress...!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033405.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
克蕾哈受托讨伐盘踞在村庄附近堡垒中的哥布林。
她立即出发，前往目标所在的堡垒，然而……
她还浑然不知，一场扭曲的情色戏剧，即将在那里上演……！
